fidelity_issues.message: Footprint and level are coarse constructive choices preserving the 060 topology; they are not photographic survey measurements.
Only the observed front post is materialized. No hidden support is promoted from structurally plausible to visually observed.
Diagonal bracing is photographically observed but omitted from this coarse orthogonal translation because no honest slender diagonal primitive is used.
The deck is spatially adjacent to the rear facade, but no ledger, anchor or embedment mechanism is asserted.
